rules.applies_when: an existing build target is identified/executed
acceptance: executed tool/config exactly match requested target
missing proprietary tool is UNAVAILABLE not substituted PASS
rules.failure_policy: continue static inspection and block target-build claim

rules.applies_when: tool execution claims a generated artifact
actions: verify each output exists and is newly produced
acceptance: every mandatory output exists and differs from stale state as expected
rules.failure_policy: reject TOOL_VERIFIED status and retain log/stale outputs separately

acceptance: calculated totals reconcile with linker summary within exact format rules
no allocated section exceeds declared region
unknown lines/fields are reported not discarded
rules.failure_policy: resource status remains UNKNOWN on unsupported format

actions: bind BIN to explicit base/address map
acceptance: every HEX record checksum and length is valid
segments do not conflict or exceed target range
raw BIN address is never guessed
rules.failure_policy: reject damaged/ambiguous image and preserve original bytes

rules.applies_when: runtime address is mapped to source/symbol
actions: normalize address for relocation/thumb/mode as applicable
rules.failure_policy: do not present stale-symbol result as root cause

acceptance: functional sections/metadata match under declared policy
claim distinguishes byte-identical from normalized reproducibility
rules.failure_policy: record non-reproducible cause and block stronger claim
